simulation.common_random_numbers_note: All engines use the same base seed. Heston, Bates-Poisson and Full Bates-Hawkes share the frozen two-factor Sobol diffusion construction; BS uses the frozen one-factor Sobol construction, so it is seed-aligned but not column-identical. Jump streams use the frozen internal offsets. WACC shocks are generated independently once and reused exactly.

path_grid.resampling: every 13th fine step to 20 Team 4 quarters

common_scenario_drift.method: Team 4 NSS curve repeated over the 13 fine steps inside each quarter
common_scenario_drift.measure: common conditional scenario drift; not estimated physical expected return

conditional_bridge.label: conditional transfer of GLD/Q distributional shape to gold USD/oz
conditional_bridge.gld_to_gold_level_conversion: NOT_PERFORMED; all engines restart at the common Team 4 gold USD/oz scenario value
conditional_bridge.interpretation: Controlled research sensitivity of distributional shape only; not fair value, target price or investment recommendation.

common_non_gold_layers.production_and_cost_note: The new runner consumes the 20 quarterly outputs/vectors imported from Team 4 ad hoc production and cost models; it does not rerun those source models and does not treat them as new stochastic processes.
common_non_gold_layers.temporary_v3_gold_driver: The Team 4 GBM/NSS gold block in v3 was a temporary gold-price driver only, separate from Team 4's ad hoc production and cost models.

selection_basis.basis: lowest in-sample IV RMSE on the frozen current surface and richest jump/variance structure
selection_basis.oos_caveat: Full Bates-Hawkes is not the one-step-ahead OOS winner; Black-Scholes has the slightly lower OOS RMSE in the frozen Team 8 validation.
